title: incident-bot: add oncall runbook quicklinks and SLO diagnostic scoring
author: Olivia Chen
description:
Motivation: On-call engineers frequently need immediate access to relevant runbooks when SLOs degrade. Existing incident-bot messages surface SLO context but require manual runbook lookup. This change adds automatic quicklink extraction and a lightweight SLO diagnostic scoring heuristic to prioritize and surface the most relevant runbooks in incident notifications.

What this PR does: - Extracts runbook links from runbook metadata (title, tags, summary) and surfaces them as compact quicklinks in incident-bot messages. - Adds a SLO diagnostic scoring module that ranks runbooks by relevance using a weighted signal of matching tags, SLO similarity, recent incident history, and runbook freshness. - Adds a quicklinks UI snippet used by Slack and email notifiers that includes impact summary, top-3 runbooks, and confidence score. - Adds unit tests for extraction/ranking, e2e test harness for Slack message formatting, and docs updates in /docs/oncall/runbooks.md.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation for runbook extraction and ranking - [x] Unit tests (extraction, ranking, edge cases) - [x] e2e formatting tests for Slack + email - [x] Backend metrics (histogram for ranking latencies, counter for link hits) - [x] Docs and changelog entry - [x] Security review for external link rendering

Backward compatibility and safety: The feature is opt-in per-organization; default behavior remains unchanged. Extracted quicklinks are sanitized and rendered via allowed-safe templates to avoid HTML/script injection. Ranking runs asynchronously and falls back to a deterministic heuristic when the model is unavailable.

Operational notes: Metrics added: incidentbot.runbook_quicklinks_generated (counter), incidentbot.runbook_ranking_latency_ms (histogram), incidentbot.runbook_link_clicks (counter). Added runbook ranking feature flag: feature.runbook_quicklinks. Rolling deploy recommended: enable flag for a small org set first, monitor link_clicks and false positives, then expand.

release_notes: Add optional runbook quicklinks and SLO diagnostic scoring for incident-bot. Feature is behind feature.runbook_quicklinks and opt-in per org. Improves on-call TTR by surfacing top runbooks and confidence scores.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature.runbook_quicklinks=false by default. To opt-in: set feature.runbook_quicklinks=true for org in deploy/feature_flags.yaml and monitor incidentbot.runbook_link_clicks and incidentbot.runbook_ranking_latency_ms. If false positives spike, reduce confidence_threshold or disable ranking.
